g.text: With the equivalence term, runs fail only where contraction is lost

text.style: font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #4c5b78

g.text: S5: all 16 inexact runs of arms with the equivalence term lie above 0.97 (so do 4 exact ones, near the edge); 11 of 22 inexact runs without the term lie below it:

text.style: font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #4c5b78

g.text: they fail by anchoring. The method's 20 S5 seeds lie at 0.61 to 0.87. Off the axis to the left: addition: all 16 runs below 0.30.

text.style: font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #4c5b78

g.text: Filled: exact; open: not. Rose: the method (M); cobalt: our earlier recipe (NS+EQ); dark grey: the other arms with the equivalence term; light grey: arms without it.
